She lives there by herself without any family and friends. What makes her life even worse is that she is not as pretty as other girls because of her lacks in physical appearance and she also not as rich as other people but she never complained. As the girls in her village had married the local lads, she decided to marry too. So, she went to the great damp swamp to look for the old basket-maker. Once she had met him, she told him to make her a husband. Then, with all the money she had, she gave it to the basket-maker and he asked her to come back after a month. The old basket-maker was greatly moved by the ugly girl because she had entrusted him with that important task. So, he makes one great husband for her. As day passes, the big day has come. Unfortunately, when she came to the swamp, the basket-maker told her that it is too early but her husband will wait her at the church tomorrow morning. After they got married, the ugly girl’s life is changing upside down. This is because her wicker husband had helped her in so many aspects in her life. These changes had been detected by her bossy neighbours. They become very jealous towards her because for them, an ugly girl like her does not deserves a husband like the wicker husband and a life she is having now. They tried everything to ruin the girl’s life but they failed, until one day they had decided to go to the old basket-maker’s place. There, they told the basket-maker that the ugly girl and her wicker husband now had a happy life but they do not have a child. Then, the villagers asked the basket-maker to make a child for the couple. Like always, he asked them to come back after a month. As month passes, now the wicker baby had been taken by the villagers. They went to the ugly girl’s house and make a slander about her husband having an affair with another woman. As she looks at the baby, instantly she just trusts what she heard from them. As from that day, her world had falling apart as she had lost her husband and the baby because she had expelled them from the house. 25 Later, after she had met back with her husband and the baby, the basket- maker had helped them to retaliate to the villagers. Since that day, the basket- maker, the ugly girl, the wicker husband and the wicker baby had gone from the village forever with all the things the basket-maker got from cheating all the greedy villagers. 26 6.0 CONCLUSIONS OF STORY After five years the ugly girl, the wicker husband, the wicker baby and the old basket-maker had gone, the life of the villagers had changed. Now, they have become better persons. One day, there was one rich family came to their village. They consist of a beautiful lady, a handsome gentleman, a cute son. All of the villagers were very shocked to hear that they were the ugly girl and her family that the villagers had once humiliated them. They revealed that the basket-maker is actually a wizard. Soon after they had gone from the village, the basket-maker had turned them into what they are now because he did not want them to suffer anymore.
